Headquarters: Remote, US

About Bitwarden

Bitwarden is the open source password and secrets management company trusted by more than 15 million users and over 80,000 businesses worldwide. Our products, including Password Manager, Secrets Manager and Passwordless.dev, help individuals, teams and enterprises secure the credentials that run their lives and their companies. We're a fully remote, growth-equity backed company in a scaling phase, and we're building the finance function to match.

About the role

This isn't a classic FP&A seat. Reporting directly to our CFO, you'll own revenue planning and reporting end to end, combining sales finance and strategic finance into one role. You'll be the person who knows our customer and revenue data cold, turns it into the plan, and puts it in front of the executive team and the board.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product and RevOps leaders on how we grow: where we invest in go-to-market, how we price and package a multi-product suite, and which drivers actually move revenue. This role is built for a finance leader who wants a real seat at the table today and sees a CFO role in their future.

What you'll do

Revenue planning and forecasting

• Build and own the revenue plan, including the annual operating plan, quarterly reforecasts and long-range model, across new business, expansion, renewal and churn.

• Model the drivers behind the number: pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle, ACV, quota capacity and ramp, NRR, GRR and logo churn.

• Partner with Sales and RevOps on headcount and capacity planning, territory and quota setting, and sales compensation design and cost.

Reporting and board materials

• Own revenue and customer reporting for the CFO, executive team and board, including ARR bridges, cohort and retention analysis, and KPI dashboards.

• Build board and investor materials that tell a clear story with accurate numbers.

• Run the monthly and quarterly business review cadence with GTM leaders, focused on what's working, what isn't and what we're changing.

Strategic finance and pricing

• Lead pricing and packaging analysis across a multi-product suite: bundle and tier modeling, discounting guardrails, price change impact and new product monetization.

• Evaluate GTM investments and new motions (channel, public sector, self-serve, enterprise) with clear ROI and payback analysis.

• Support deal desk on non-standard deals, multi-year terms and pricing exceptions.

Data integrity and systems

• Be the source of truth for revenue and customer data. Reconcile CRM, billing and ERP data so bookings, billings, ARR and revenue tie out.

• Partner with Accounting on revenue recognition (ASC 606) inputs and with RevOps on CRM hygiene and definitions.

• Own and improve our FP&A planning platform and customer revenue cube, and push for automation over spreadsheets.

Team and leadership

• Build and lead a small, high-performing revenue finance team as the function scales.

• Act as a trusted thought partner to executives, and challenge assumptions with data when the plan and reality don't match.

What you bring

• 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, sales finance, strategic finance or a mix, with at least 3 years leading revenue planning.

• B2B SaaS experience is required, ideally in a PE or growth-equity backed company where you've lived through operating plans, value creation plans and board and lender reporting.

• Experience helping a SaaS business scale through a major growth stage, such as from roughly $50M to $100M+ in ARR, including the systems and process growing pains that come with it.

• Deep fluency in SaaS revenue metrics and classic sales motion KPIs: bookings, ARR, NRR and GRR, CAC payback, LTV, pipeline coverage, win rates, quota attainment and capacity.

• Hands-on experience working with large customer and billing datasets. You're comfortable getting into the data yourself, and SQL or BI tool experience (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus.

• A track record of pricing and packaging work across multiple products or tiers.

• Experience building board-level materials and presenting directly to executives.

• Working knowledge of the finance stack: CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot), ERP (NetSuite or similar), FP&A planning software (Adaptive, Pigment, Anaplan or similar) and customer revenue cube or subscription analytics tools.

• High ownership and high standards. You set the pace, you sweat the accuracy of your numbers, and you don't wait to be told what to fix.

• Ambition to grow into a CFO role, and the executive presence to earn that path.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

Nice to have

• MBA or CPA.

• Experience with hybrid revenue models: self-serve or product-led alongside enterprise sales.

• Exposure to channel, partner or public sector revenue models.

• Security, identity or developer tools industry experience.

• Experience in a fully remote company or with globally distributed teams.

• Background in investment banking, PE or consulting before moving into operating finance.

Why this role

• Direct line to the CFO and real exposure to the executive team and board.

• A scaling company where your models shape actual decisions on pricing, GTM investment and product strategy.

• Room to build: the team, the tooling and the operating cadence are yours to shape.

• A mission that matters. Our products protect millions of people and businesses every day.

About the Role:
We are looking for an exceptional Staff Engineer to shape the architecture and evolution of our data infrastructure as we scale.

Our engineering ecosystem operates multiple database technologies, handles large volumes of data and traffic, and supports a growing number of services and engineering teams.
We need a strong individual contributor who has built and scaled distributed data systems, understands database technologies at a fundamental level, and can solve complex infrastructure challenges across multiple engineering teams.

This role goes beyond operating existing databases. You will design systems, build infrastructure capabilities, challenge architectural limitations, and drive technical initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, performance, and infrastructure economics.
What You'll Do:

• 
Architect for scale: Design and evolve distributed data architectures capable of supporting significant growth in traffic, data volume, and engineering complexity.

• 
Build infrastructure platforms: Develop reusable infrastructure components, frameworks, and platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to build scalable systems.

• 
Drive architectural evolution: Identify fundamental limitations in existing systems and lead large-scale initiatives involving data distribution, sharding, replication, migrations, and architectural modernization.

• 
Shape technical strategy: Influence database technology choices, architectural patterns, and long-term infrastructure direction across the company.

• 
Improve infrastructure economics: Lead engineering initiatives that materially improve scalability, resource efficiency, and infrastructure costs.

• 
Engineer for reliability: Design systems that remain available and resilient under high throughput, infrastructure failures, and changing workload patterns.

• 
Create organizational leverage: Establish engineering standards and reusable solutions that eliminate recurring problems across teams.

• 
Lead through technical influence: Work with senior engineers and engineering leadership to turn ambiguous, company-level challenges into executable technical programs.

What We're Looking For:

• 9+ years of strong software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale data platforms, with demonstrated Staff-level technical impact.

• Strong software engineering background with experience designing and building production infrastructure, not only operating or administering it.

• Experience architecting systems handling multi-terabyte datasets and 30K–50K+ operations per second, or comparable large-scale distributed workloads.

• Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, concurrency, fault tolerance, and data distribution.

• Strong hands-on experience with both relational and NoSQL database architectures, including their design principles, scalability characteristics, and trade-offs.

• Experience leading complex architectural initiatives involving multiple systems and engineering teams.
Ability to identify systemic technical problems and design solutions that improve infrastructure across the organization.

• Strong technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to influence architectural decisions without formal authority.

Tech Experience:

We value engineering depth and architectural understanding over familiarity with a long list of technologies.

Strong experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, combined with experience in one or more distributed database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar systems, is highly relevant.

Experience with distributed SQL, search infrastructure, analytical databases, or other large-scale storage systems is an advantage.

We do not expect expertise in any particular combination of database products. What matters is the ability to understand their internals, evaluate trade-offs, and design scalable infrastructure around them.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:

You have previously taken ownership of challenging infrastructure problems where the solution required more than improving an individual service or database.

You have designed or significantly evolved distributed architectures, built infrastructure adopted by multiple teams, led complex technical transformations, or enabled systems to operate at substantially greater scale.

You are equally comfortable discussing database internals, distributed systems trade-offs, and long-term architecture as you are working with engineers to turn those decisions into production systems.

Your impact is measured by the systems you enable, the architectural problems you eliminate, and the engineering capabilities you leave behind.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab, and working to restore the voices of one million people living with permanent voice loss through our 1 Million Voices initiative (learn more at elevenlabs.io/impact). We're looking for a Producer to own the external storytelling and event presence for Impact, a role that coordinates PR, agency management, social launches, documentary-style case studies, and event production. This is a hands-on, in-house role: you're the person who makes sure every launch, film, and activation meets (or, ideally raises) the bar of the rest of the company's output, working closely with our internal Design, Comms, and Events teams, and, when applicable, with the external agencies and production teams supporting PR, film, and creative execution. Much of Impact’s work is made with people who live with a disability, or are members of vulnerable communities. You will ensure their views carry equal weight and their input helps shape every project, from first conversation to final cut. As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast; this quarter alone includes more than five events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight.

What you'll do
• 
Coordinate production of Impact's documentary case studies: travel and work onsite for filming when needed, work closely with external production and direction teams, bringing opinions on story and craft, and partner with our Design team to make sure every film meets ElevenLabs' bar and brand guidelines.
• 
Work alongside subjects of our case studies, many of whom live with a disability, as equals and ensure that the production team does the same. You will build in consent, access needs, and editorial input at every stage to ensure alignment in how the story is told, cut, and shared.
• 
Plan and execute Impact's conferences and activations alongside the Events team, turning each one into an in-person moment that drives real ROI and leaves a lasting impression, with Impact's own storytelling angle built in.
• 
Support Comms in telling Impact's story through PR, coordinating with Comms and, when applicable, a PR agency to keep press windows and partner announcements on track, and helping make sure Impact's international stories get told well as the program expands globally.
• 
Partner with Design to keep all video and static collateral on-brand, advocating for a high creative standard and Impact’s lens.
• 
Carry a consistent visual and narrative thread across launches, blog content, and ElevenLabs Summit presentations.
• 
Draft copy for social and blog content, collaborating with Comms to land a final draft, and with Design on all launch-related visual assets.
• 
Manage multiple concurrent launches, shoots, and events at once.

Requirements
• 
A great project manager with a sharp creative eye, someone who runs cross-functional logistics flawlessly, has real taste, and will push the team to hit it.
• 
Proven practical experience working with vulnerable communities, especially people living with a disability, and ensuring they are provided the time, space and accommodation to be equal partners in high-pressure productions, on tight timelines, and in public.
• 
Organized and detail-oriented, with a track record of juggling several production timelines at once.
• 
Creative or production background (agency, marketing, in-house brand/content team, documentary or branded content) comfortable being on set and in the room with Design, not just commissioning the work.
• 
Strong writing and visual taste; can tell when something is on-brand and polish-worthy.
• 
2-5 years of experience in production, events, or brand marketing.
• 
Comfortable traveling for shoots and events.

• 

Customer Retention: The percentage of customers you successfully retain within your assigned portfolio.

• 

Customer Portfolio: The number of customers you manage while maintaining a high standard of service and engagement.

• 

Onboarding & Activation: How effectively you guide customers through technical implementation, complete their setup, and help them start using HYROS.

Customer Satisfaction: The quality of your customer relationships, feedback, and ability to resolve issues proactively.

Understand HYROS, our onboarding playbooks, internal processes, and customer journey.

Become familiar with our tracking technology, integrations, and common implementation challenges.

Understand how platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, CRMs, and payment processors connect with HYROS.

Start hosting onboarding calls and guiding your first customers through their setup.

Learn how to troubleshoot common tracking, integration, and data validation issues.

Become comfortable helping customers install tracking scripts, configure integrations, validate events, and troubleshoot setup issues.

Independently manage your first customer portfolio and keep onboarding progress on track.

Identify potential setup or engagement risks early and take action before they become bigger problems.

Develop a strong understanding of how customers use HYROS data to improve their advertising decisions.

Take full ownership of your assigned customers, from onboarding through activation and ongoing adoption.

Independently handle most common technical onboarding challenges, knowing when deeper technical support is needed.

Run effective customer training sessions and explain complex tracking concepts in a simple, practical way.

• 

Help customers understand their attribution data and turn it into actionable business decisions.

• 

Proactively manage customer engagement, satisfaction, and retention risks.

• 

Maintain strong relationships and consistently positive customer feedback.

First 180 Days — Consistent Performance

• 

Independently manage a growing customer portfolio while maintaining a high standard of customer service.

• 

Consistently deliver successful onboarding, strong adoption, and positive customer retention.

• 

Become a trusted advisor who helps customers make better marketing and business decisions using HYROS.

• 

Demonstrate strong technical confidence across common integrations, tracking setups, and troubleshooting scenarios.

• 

Identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency, customer experience, and retention.

• 

Contribute to improving internal playbooks, processes, and best practices.

What We're Looking For

• 

5+ years of Customer Success experience, ideally in SaaS.

• 

Experience managing high-touch or strategic customers.

Strong understanding of customer onboarding, adoption, and retention.

Comfort working in technical customer environments. You don't need to be a developer, but technical implementations shouldn't intimidate you.

Comfortable understanding how websites, funnels, tracking scripts, integrations, pixels/events, and customer data connect at a practical level.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex or technical topics simple.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

Comfortable using data and customer signals to prioritize and take action.

A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You don't wait for problems to become escalations.

Big Plus

Experience with marketing analytics, paid advertising, ad tracking, attribution, conversion tracking, e-commerce, or technical SaaS products.

Experience with platforms and tools such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, Intercom, or ChurnZero.
